scope: Small in-process frozen source collection using real JournalDeltaStore/native content pins/FileWorkspaceProvider; synthetic immutable basis; no WinFsp mount/provider process or Editor
baseline: 8709f90 + ST-61–64; six changed Runtime/Files source hashes exactly match prior recorded evidence
candidate: Same sources + ST-65–68; current source hashes match reference-proof-20261102.json

input.metadata: Fixed time/attributes; touched file write time explicitly fixed to 100+round
input.mutation: Two bytes at offset 2 of data000 replaced once per generation

timing.definition: Freeze + independent preservation/publication + capture-finalization, six captures summed; editing/setup and final independent checks excluded
timing.secondBlockReason: One additional fixed ABBA block after large monotonic variation in the first; no further repetitions
timing.verdict: No consistent elapsed-time improvement demonstrated. First block regresses 7.98%; second improves 1.61%, only 56ms across six captures. Do not pool blocks into a speedup.

definition.catalog.entries: Non-root catalog entries yielded by ordinary Walk plus nodes actually visited by CatalogReadScope; cached subtrees excluded
definition.metadata.enumeratedRows: Rows yielded by paged metadata tree cursors across capture; separate from catalog entries and not additive
definition.metadata.pageDecodes: ReadNodeCore decoding after logical cache miss; not OS read syscall count
definition.hash.total: SHA passes/bytes at PayloadHash, composed VerifyFile, raw HashRange, immutable native proof miss, source ScanTree and private-range preparation. Excludes metadata/control/address hashes and separate journal-segment seal hashing; not all process SHA256 calls
definition.accounting.referenceRows: Physical reference rows contributed by current/historical manifests before exact deduplication
definition.retention.inputRows: Calls encoding retained dependencies, including duplicates before membership checking

counts.stageTimingWarning: Nested diagnostic intervals overlap; not additive and not an extra matched timing claim

interpretation: Targeted work falls, but only 2,639 instrumented hash bytes are saved and actual metadata decodes fall 5.8%. First-block timing drift cause is unisolated; this input does not show useful whole-capture acceleration. Remaining scan/preservation/native publication costs are still present; no causal flush/CPU attribution was measured.

budgets.cancellation: Token deadlines and boundary checks block subsequent phases; preserve failed fixture and intents; no forced termination

limits: No product source or existing state modified by measurement
No OS-cache flush, CPU-affinity control, background-load control or RAM/hardware-utilization measurement
Only two ABBA blocks and one counter run per variant; every run is a new process and fresh physical fixture
All result histories verified after the synthetic basis became unavailable; actual source-provider lifetime qualification is separate
No automatic deletion/reclamation of benchmark fixtures, no commit/push
